newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle $68, limited test-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle $68, limited test-USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter heifers $1.00 lower, no sales reported on slaughter steers.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 700 slaughter heifers following the weekly movement of 89,000 head. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1100 lbs 68.00. Confirmed - 700
